description: The shapes the newer forms are shared through, so that a newtype crossing a file is exercised as well as one declared where it is used.

A newtype is the form most likely to live in a vocabulary: an identifier is exactly the sort of thing several contracts pass around, and a name for it is only worth having if every contract that passes it agrees on the name.

types.name: TraceId
description: Which chain of calls this one belongs to.
A string on the wire, and a distinct type wherever a target has such a thing. Two contracts that both carry one must not have to agree in prose that their two strings are the same string.

types.name: Meta
description: When something happened, and what chain it belonged to.

fields.name: at_ms
description: Wall clock, in milliseconds. Inside the range every target holds exactly, which is what the keyword promises.

fields.name: trace
description: The chain. An imported newtype used as a field's type is the case the folder layout has to reach across a directory for.
